name: Mochizuki Shima
source:
"You shouldn't easily place your faith in other people."

Shima wanders around the country at will, unbound by any restrictions. He may be friendly, but he never reveals his innermost thoughts. What is his hidden past, shrouded in mystery?

Temperament: Whimsical and amiable
Familiar: Ten
